images.alt: Blue square graphic tile with text: Intake matters. 1 in 6 NZ adults experience hazardous drinking. Six human icons shown, one in red to represent the statistic. Includes New Zealand Government and Ministry of Health logos.

post.text:
Our latest Health Survey shows hazardous drinking among people aged 15+ has decreased from 21.3% in 2019-2020 to 16.6% in 2024-2025. 

With the holiday period coming, it’s a timely reminder that alcohol use can impact health and wellbeing. 

Find out more key findings from our Health Survey below.
